scene: The launched rocket showers sparkling sparks, illuminating three waiting transit platforms.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a cobblestone transit plaza. On the left, a noodle-cart monorail sits ready on its track. In the centre, the player in red bomber jacket and roller skates stands beside an open bamboo cable car. On the far right, a gleaming rooftop escalator hums upward. Overhead, colorful celebratory fireworks burst brightly.
shown: a steaming noodle-cart monorail car waiting on a rail on the left
a suspended green bamboo cable car with its door open in the centre
a glowing rooftop escalator leading steeply upwards on the far right
